job.name: ig3_host
job.person_note: The woman must be exactly the presenter from the attached board (same face, short dark pixie haircut).
job.meaning: ведущая с борда «Табло лифта» ~28: короткая тёмная стрижка, чёрная водолазка с янтарной деталью, фон — тёмная стальная стена лифтового холла с янтарной подсветкой; по пояс, обе руки в кадре, лицо нейтральное, губы приоткрыты, без улыбки, фотореализм, без надписей
job.prompt: Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, of exactly the presenter woman from the attached board (same face, short dark pixie haircut) — a confident, likeable storyteller about 28, NOT a fashion model, natural skin texture. FRAMING (very important): waist-up, centred, BOTH shoulders and BOTH arms fully inside the frame with generous margin (at least 12% of width) on left and right, hands relaxed at waist level holding nothing. Top of the head about 18% of frame height below the upper edge; face large and sharp. Expression: lively eyes, face NEUTRAL as in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted with a hint of teeth, NO smile. Clothes: black turtleneck with a thin amber #FFB000 detail. Background: a dark elevator lobby wall of brushed steel #3A3D42, softly out of focus, with a warm amber #FFB000 glow; soft key light on the face. No text, no letters, no logos, nothing covering the face, no headphones, no microphone.
